notes: Independently challenged all 17 candidates against accessible official fee, location and AI sources. Direct HTTPS retrieval was used for Springer, Elsevier, Wiley publisher, Taylor & Francis publisher, JSS, IJIEM and JEMC; SJM author instructions and INCOSE manual were read via web retrieval.

Wiley journal and some INCOSE and society pages, both ScienceDirect journals and T&F journal-specific instructions were inaccessible to independent retrieval; associated findings retain the limitations and prior-agent evidence rather than inventing a contrary result. Springer group guidance requires human oversight, Methods reporting for research use and an end-of-paper AI declaration; Elsevier policy separately addresses research code/analysis and drafting.

Four new Springer venues and SoSyM have added 2025 citation metrics. Previously sourced historical metrics retained; no acceptance rate is derived and no difficulty bands are added. This is agent evidence review, not human scientific review.
